launches.name: Kanwas
launches.tagline: An open-source brain for your team
launches.description: For you, your agent, your coworker and their agent. It holds the team's critical know-how, research, decisions and data. But it's not a dead storage. It's a workspace that makes the context workable for humans as well as agents.

launches.name: Superset 2.0
launches.tagline: Run 100s of coding agents on any machine from anywhere
launches.description: Run 100s parallel coding agents, offload them to different machines. Rewritten from scratch to support remote workspaces. Share and collaborate with teammates in realtime. Works for any CLI agent.

launches.name: pay.sh
launches.tagline: Discover, access, and pay for any API autonomously
launches.description: In collaboration with Google Cloud, we're building the open source real-time payment infrastructure for AI agents so they can discover and pay per call for any API.

launches.name: Gyro Autopilot
launches.tagline: 100s of Dollars Could Be Sitting in Your Inbox 📥
launches.description: Scan your inbox for unclaimed flight money from delays, cancellations, overbookings, and more. Gyro Autopilot finds what you’re owed and claims it automatically. No win, no fee. No commitment. No credit card.

launches.name: WOZCODE
launches.tagline: Cut Claude Code costs by up to 50%
launches.description: WOZCODE is an efficiency layer for Claude Code. It helps developers spend fewer tokens, finish tasks faster, and improve agent performance without switching IDEs, subscriptions, or workflows. Install it in two commands and get more value from every Claude Code session.

launches.name: Contrario
launches.tagline: The AI recruiting platform powered by expert recruiters
launches.description: Recruiting tools won't get you the hire. The right team will. Contrario combines a network of expert recruiters with AI agents built for hiring. Our recruiters and agents handle 90% of the work — sourcing, screening, coordination, and closing — all from Slack via natural language. With every decision, the system learns your bar and surfaces better candidates over time.

launches.name: Ads in ChatGPT
launches.tagline: Create, manage, and measure your ChatGPT ad campaigns
launches.description: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT ads with a beta self-serve Ads Manager for US advertisers, partner-based buying, CPC bidding, CPM campaigns, conversion measurement, and aggregated reporting, while keeping ads clearly labeled and separate from ChatGPT answers.

launches.name: Gas City 1.0
launches.tagline: build your own software factory
launches.description: The successor to Gas Town, Gas City is the OSS platform software engineers use to build software factories that builds, deploys, operates, and maintains their software products. Orchestrate your favorite CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and more) to their non-deterministic output into product-quality solutions. features, schedule, quality: pick three.

launches.name: Realtime TTS-2
launches.tagline: Voice AI that feels as good as it sounds
launches.description: Realtime TTS 1.5 is #1 on Artificial Analysis, voted best in blind tests by thousands of real users. TTS-2 builds on that with six major upgrades: natural language voice direction for tone, emotion, speed, and pitch. Text-based voice design, where you describe a voice in words and generate it. Cross-lingual synthesis across 100+ languages preserving speaker identity. IPA phonetic control for brand names and rare words. And improved alphanumeric pronunciation. Try it free at inworld.ai/tts.

launches.name: Magic
launches.tagline: Blend your content into real-world locations
launches.description: Upload your content, choose from 350+ templates, and watch the magic happen — your product placed inside real filmed footage from Paris, Times Square, Tokyo and beyond. The most consistent results on the market: sharp logos, accurate colors, predictable quality every time. Trusted by L'Oréal, Anua, Renova, Verge, and brands across 50+ countries. Starting from $1 per video.

launches.name: Open Finance MCP
launches.tagline: Access your bank data in ChatGPT & Claude via Open Finance
launches.description: What if your AI assistant could see your actual bank statements? The Open Finance Data MCP connects your bank account to ChatGPT, Claude, and any MCP-compatible AI — through Brazil's Open Finance. Ask about spending, get summaries, analyze patterns in natural language. No account needed — authenticate via Open Finance (your CPF + your bank). Your data, your control — revoke anytime. Setup takes 2 minutes. Built by Cumbuca, a licensed Payment Institution in Brazil.

launches.name: moar
launches.tagline: Your documents. AI ready.
launches.description: No more "file too large." moar extracts real structure from any document and delivers clean, right-sized Markdown or CSV for every AI tool you use including ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Up to 95% token savings. Zero loss of meaning. Supports nine formats: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, MD, JSON and HTML. Files up to 50 MB each. moar is built from the ground up to be 100% private. Your documents never leave your device.

launches.name: Ajelix AI Agent for Work
launches.tagline: The first truly agentic AI sidebar for Google Workspace™
launches.description: Ajelix’s AI agents are now available inside your Google Sheets™, Docs™, Slides™, and Forms™. Your selected agent can research the web, write and execute Google Apps Scripts, build charts and visualizations, design presentations, calculate and analyze data, draft content, and deliver finished, production-ready results. Built for Digital Professionals, Managers, Founders and SMBs.

launches.name: Knowly 1.0
launches.tagline: LLM Wiki + NotebookLM, in one closed-loop Proactive AI
launches.description: Knowly = Karpathy's LLM Wiki + NotebookLM in one closed-loop proactive AI for learning. Save anything → Knowly auto-organizes it, builds understanding of every source, and takes you to a personalized learning flow on demand.

launches.name: Kaneo
launches.tagline: All you need. Nothing you don't.
launches.description: Most project management tools get in the way more than they help, not because they lack features, but because they have too many. Every notification, every button, every workflow pulls teams away from what matters: shipping. Kaneo is the opposite. Every feature earns its place. Board, list, and Gantt on the same data. Time tracking, workflow rules, GitHub and Gitea integrations, OIDC SSO, an MCP server for AI agents. Self-host or cloud. Open source, MIT.

launches.name: Clipo AI — One Video, 20 Content Pieces
launches.tagline: One video → clips, carousels, personalized posts, img & more
launches.description: Creators record one great video, then spend hours cutting it into clips, posts, and carousels using 5-10 tools. Clipo replaces all of them. One upload → 20 pieces of content in minutes. Social ready AI clips with virality scores. Keyword and visual search for exact moments. Branded carousels from transcript. LinkedIn and Twitter posts in your voice. Thumbnails, subtitles, screenshots, AI images. Edit video like a document — no timeline. AI proposes. You decide. Free to start, no credit card.

launches.name: Impulse AI
launches.tagline: From plain English to deployed ML model in an hour
launches.description: Impulse is an autonomous ML engineer. Describe a prediction problem in plain English, connect your data, get a deployed model with an API in under an hour. Our agent placed top 2.5% on a Kaggle competition. 782 of 31,791, with zero human intervention. No prompt engineering, no tuning. AutoML tools need configuration. No-code builders stop at a trained model. Impulse handles the full workflow: cleaning, feature engineering, model selection, leakage checks, deployment, and monitoring.

launches.name: Troubleshooting Agent by Pluno
launches.tagline: Debugs customer issues before engineers do
launches.description: Support tickets shouldn’t pull engineers away from building. Pluno does the investigation. It connects to your codebase, database, Sentry, session recordings, logs, and 3,000+ tools, traces complex customer issues end to end, finds the root cause, gathers evidence, and proposes the fix. Engineers stop digging through tools and start reviewing clear answers. Not another escalation. A troubleshooting teammate.

launches.name: AI Actions
launches.tagline: AI that doesn't just chat, it takes actions.
launches.description: Most AI assistants stop at the answer. AI Actions lets yours go further. Add actions from templates (REST API, databases, Slack, email) or import an entire MCP server. Link them to your assistant. It reads the conversation, picks the right action, runs it, and responds — automatically. No hardcoded logic. No extra prompting. Just an AI that moves the needle.

launches.name: Kit 🏵️
launches.tagline: Editor, Browser, Mail, Terminal, Agents. AI at the center.
launches.description: Five windows pretending to be one workflow. Kit puts your editor, browser, terminal, git, email, calendar, whiteboard and an autonomous agent in one window; AI has live context across all of them. 🤖 Kit Agent: autonomous AI with per-action permission control 🌐 Real browser: AI-powered summarize and extract 🪜 Stairs: chain AI + shell + HTTP + file steps 🔀 Git panel: stage, commit, push visually 📋kitrules: teach the agent your conventions Open source. MIT. macOS and Linux. Extendable ❤️

launches.name: Platos | The runtime for Managed Agents
launches.tagline: Your agents. Your servers. Your keys. Your model.
launches.description: Platos is the open source runtime for shipping AI agents to production. Customer chatbots, internal copilots, AI employees, research agents, anything that needs memory and tools. One docker compose up gives you the full stack - persistent memory across sessions, durable background ops, full MCP gateway, cost dashboards, trace timelines, audit logs, drop-in React widget. Wrap any function with one decorator and it becomes a typed MCP tool. BYOK any LLM.

launches.name: Tvara
launches.tagline: Sales Made Easy & Predictable.
launches.description: Tvara helps sales teams with who to sell, when to sell and how to sell. It brings WhatsApp, email, and phone calls into one connected platform where every interaction is recorded, monitored, and searchable. Every lead is treated with importance, every follow-up is tracked, and every sales team gets a clearer way to sell, manage, and grow.

launches.name: ChannelScout
launches.tagline: Scout the channels where your first users are hiding.
launches.description: Generic AI advice burns tokens. Generic "post on Reddit" filler wastes weeks. Scout solves both. How it works: Drop your app's URL and answer a few questions to get back a ranked Blueprint of the actual rooms where indie apps like yours get noticed (subreddits, Discords, newsletters, X, TikTok, wherever your people are), a 30-day roadmap sized to your real free hours, a brand guide downloadable free, and copy in your voice. Built by someone who learned the hard way so you don't have to.

launches.name: Buddy
launches.tagline: Voice First AI assistant for macOS
launches.description: Hold Control + Option on your Mac, ask anything about what's on your screen, and Buddy answers out loud with a warm, natural voice. Also, You’re never alone with our cursor buddy! It lives right on your screen, pointing things out and helping you navigate your Mac with ease.

launches.name: QualityMax
launches.tagline: AI QA that writes, runs, and heals tests
launches.description: QualityMax turns specs, app crawls, and repo context into runnable Playwright, pytest, Go, Rust, and k6 test suites. Run them in cloud, locally, or CI with traces, gates, artifacts, and self-healing. qmax-code brings the QA agent into Codex and Claude Code workflows.

launches.name: MoltPe
launches.tagline: A wallet for your AI agent. Not access to yours.
launches.description: MoltPe is payment infrastructure for AI agents. Each agent gets its own isolated payment identity with hard spending controls — daily caps, per-transaction limits, recipient allowlists — enforced at the signing layer. The agent physically cannot overspend, even if reasoning goes wrong. • Sub-second settlement • Native x402, MPP, MCP, REST • Drops into Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf in 3 lines of config • Free tier, no credit card, no US entity required Built for the agentic economy.

launches.name: Noryen
launches.tagline: Monitor, compare and catch risky AI outputs
launches.description: I was building another app in a sensitive niche (health) and at some point it hit me: my AI could randomly recommend medication, dosages or just say something completely unsafe… and I wouldn’t even know. This could lead to legal issues, broken user trust and unpredictable outputs. So I built Noryen in order to understand how my AI behaves in production Simple and built for those who don’t fully trust their AI.

launches.name: deepface.dev
launches.tagline: Plug-and-play face verification API
launches.description: deepface.dev makes face verification, embeddings, and vector comparison available through one managed API, so developers do not need to run infrastructure (this is all based on the opensource Deepface project by Sefik Serengil). We aimed to be developer friendly with transparent usage-based pricing, privacy-first controls, predictable latency, and AI-friendly access. AI agents can get anonymous keys with free calls/month, with higher free monthly limits for signed-up users and saved-card users.

launches.name: HailBytes SAT
launches.tagline: Self-hosted security awareness training in your AWS/Azure
launches.description: Phishing simulation and security awareness training that runs entirely in your own AWS or Azure account. 45+ industry-specific templates, AI-driven campaign generation via MCP, interactive quizzes, branded PDF completion certificates, OIDC SSO, and SOC 2/ISO 27001 audit evidence. Unlimited campaigns for unlimited users on a single marketplace subscription. $0.24/vCPU/hr vs. $30K+/year per-seat licensing from KnowBe4 or Proofpoint Security Awareness.

launches.name: Self Evolving Software Template
launches.tagline: Build and Deploy any SaaS - open source Claude Skills
launches.description: Build your own vibe-coding platform(or any SaaS usecase) on the template behind DevOpser Lite. Working dev environment in 5 minutes. Express + Postgres + Redis, pluggable AI chat (Bedrock/OpenAI/Anthropic), auth + MFA, admin panel, Capacitor mobile. Customize as deep as you want. Deploy to any target.

launches.name: Invoicey
launches.tagline: AI-powered invoicing and quotes for freelancers.
launches.description: Free AI invoice generator, estimate maker & receipt creator — all in one simple invoicing software. Create PDF invoices, estimates, and receipts in seconds…

launches.name: AI Hive
launches.tagline: Build, deploy, and run all your AI agents in one platform.
launches.description: Most enterprise AI platforms treat compliance as an afterthought. AI Hive ships it from day one. Build AI agents visually — no code required. Deploy in your cloud, on your servers, or white-labeled under your brand. Pick your LLM: GPT-4o, Claude, or Gemini. Connect 50+ tools natively. PII masking, audit trails, RBAC, and guardrails are standard — ready for GDPR, HIPAA, and the EU AI Act out of the box. Built on 18+ years of enterprise software delivery.

launches.name: Absliq
launches.tagline: AI that executes support workflows, not just replies
launches.description: Support is broken. AI replies haven’t fixed it. Most tools generate responses. But support isn’t about replies. It is about getting things done. Absliq is an execution-first AI platform that resolves support tickets by taking real actions across your systems. Instead of just answering users, Absliq can: Trigger workflows Call APIs Update systems Take actions needed to resolve the issue From ticket → action → resolution. Built for teams who want AI to do the work, not just assist.

launches.name: Shadow 2.0
launches.tagline: The work your meetings create, done before they end
launches.description: Every online call creates a to-do list. Shadow clears it live. It understands your conversation, tracks what needs to happen, and executes tasks in real time. PDF creation, slide generation, CRM updates, follow-ups, and scheduling before the call ends. Our goal is to have no post-call work. Just stay focused while Shadow handles everything in the background. Starting with core workflows and expanding to everything your calls create.

launches.name: Custom Integrations by Databox
launches.tagline: Bring missing data into Databox without writing code
launches.description: Custom Integrations lets you connect virtually any API to Databox without writing code. Turn API responses into structured datasets and analyze them alongside your other sources to get a complete view of performance.

launches.name: Alumni Founder
launches.tagline: The tool that maps founder networks for any company
launches.description: Enter any company or university and see the complete founder network it produced. Who spun out, how they're connected, how strong those connections are, and how much they've raised - mapped as a live visual graph. Used by VCs for deal sourcing, sales teams for warm intros, and founders looking for co-founders.

launches.name: DevAlly
launches.tagline: AI powered accessibility compliance for teams who ship fast
launches.description: Whether you’re starting or scaling your accessibility compliance program, DevAlly helps product teams automate and streamline compliance under EAA, ADA and Section 508.

launches.name: damnlines.com
launches.tagline: No one likes waiting in a damn line.
launches.description: No one likes waiting in a damn line. Track live line activity for NYC restaurants and venues with real-time queue snapshots and wait-time signals. See wait times at L'Industrie, Salt Hank's, and more.

launches.name: Magic Studio by Once UI
launches.tagline: Turn Once UI into a $10k agency
launches.description: Magic Studio is a white-label frontend system built on Once UI. It gives you everything you need to launch and sell high-end frontend projects: landing pages, dashboards, docs, and a studio site — all consistent and ready to customise. Built for freelancers, agencies, and developers who want to sell premium work without starting from scratch.

launches.name: Spotit
launches.tagline: Your cursor's tutor. For every Mac app.
launches.description: Press a key on your Mac. Ask "how do I mask a layer in Photoshop?" Spotit highlights the next click. Walks you through every step. You do the clicking. You learn as you go. Next time, you won't need it for that thing.

launches.name: GetDynasty
launches.tagline: Exit tax-free using Trusts. For startup founders.
launches.description: The tax strategy wealthy founders use to exit tax-free, now available to every founder. Most founders lose ~30% of their wealth to taxes at exit, while family offices and ultra-wealthy entrepreneurs use QSBS Stacking to exit tax-free. Dynasty productizes the entire process, so every founder can access the most powerful tax strategy in startup history at a fraction of the traditional cost.

launches.name: Threelane
launches.tagline: Open-source screen + multi-cam recorder & editor
launches.description: Recording and editing multi-cam demos is fiddly, and every tool that makes it smooth is paid. Threelane is the open-source alternative: screen + webcam + your phone as a second camera over WiFi, multi-track editor with zoom lanes that follow your cursor and trim lanes that skip bad takes, portrait/landscape/square layouts, export to MP4. Runs locally no cloud, no account for Mac · Windows · Linux. Free forever.

launches.name: Weez AI
launches.tagline: Where Marketing Runs Itself
launches.description: We’re launching the first version of Weez AI focused on helping SaaS founders and small teams automate their marketing execution. With this launch, you can: Generate high-performing content and creatives Launch campaigns across platforms Track performance in one place Continuously improve results with AI This is the first step toward a fully autonomous marketing system.

launches.name: Space
launches.tagline: A quiet canvas for the things you want to keep.
launches.description: Space is a calm, personal canvas where your ideas live as mixed media. Sticky notes, images, web clips, voice memos, drawings, documents and checklists, all arranged freely on an infinite, zoomable board.

launches.name: InfraDesk
launches.tagline: Cut your AWS bill by 30% — one click, rollback anytime
launches.description: InfraDesk automatically detects AWS waste, suggests one-click fixes with rollback, and proves every dollar saved. Built for engineering teams worldwide — $29/month, no lock-in.

launches.name: IssueClear
launches.tagline: Client-friendly issue tracking for freelancers and clients.
launches.description: IssueClear is a client-friendly issue tracker for freelancers. Capture requests, comments, files, and approvals in one shared workflow so client work stays clear, organized, and easy to deliver.

launches.name: ILLLL — Live Longer
launches.tagline: Staying healthy should be free
launches.description: The longevity industry sells $200/month supplements and 4am cold-plunge routines. The actual research points to 6 simple daily habits — sleep, exercise, breathing, morning light, healthy food, gratitude — that cost nothing and take seconds to track. ILLLL is a private, source-available app that helps you do them.

launches.name: 168: Time Budget
launches.tagline: 168 hours a week. Budget them like money.
launches.description: 168 hours per week. Treat them like money. No streaks. No notifications. No leaderboards. Nothing to game — just an honest weekly receipt of where your time actually went. You're an adult. Budget your week like one.

launches.name: Homerockr
launches.tagline: Home maintenance made easy – Protect your home's value
launches.description: The easy way to manage your home. Plan maintenance with ready-to-use templates, run guided inspections, and keep track of your maintenance projects. The Home Value Retention Index shows you the state of your home at a single glance. Protect your investment, stay organized, and avoid costly surprises.

launches.name: Sell AI — Snap, List, Sold
launches.tagline: Get a ready-to-post listing in sec on Vinted, Ebay & more
launches.description: Sell smarter. List faster. Turn any item in your wardrobe into a ready-to-publish listing in seconds. Just take a photo — Sell AI generates a title, description and smart price, tailored for Vinted, Depop, eBay and more. Perfect for resellers, vintage lovers or anyone decluttering. No typing, no guesswork — just snap, copy and sell. Your next sale is one photo away.

launches.name: Pitara
launches.tagline: Windows Photo Search — find any photo instantly in English
launches.description: Pitara is a Windows photo search tool that finds any photo in your library in under half a second using plain English. No cloud upload, no account, no GPU, no subscription. Everything runs on your machine. Your photos already contain everything needed to find them. GPS location, date, camera model, altitude. Pitara reads that metadata, builds a local index using Apache Lucene, and makes your entire Windows photo library instantly searchable. Type what you remember. Results under half a second.

launches.name: RAW - Developer Toolkit
launches.tagline: 30+ dev tools in one place fast, free, and 100% client-side.
launches.description: 30 free browser-based developer tools. Format JSON, decode JWT tokens, encode Base64, generate UUIDs, hash text, and more. 100% client-side — no data sent to servers.

launches.name: Client Side RAR & ZIP Opener
launches.tagline: Open RAR & ZIP in your browser. No upload, no install.
launches.description: Tired of uploading sensitive files to random "online unzip" services? Nesdzo Archive Opener processes your file entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device. No upload, no queue, no file size limit beyond your own memory. - RAR and ZIP support - Browse contents before extracting - Download individual files or everything at once - Works on Mac, Windows, Linux, Chromebook, even mobile Safari Built by Nesdzo. Free. No account needed.

launches.name: Goal Accomplishment Made Easy™
launches.tagline: Project management for your personal and professional goals
launches.description: You tell Goal Accomplishment Made Easy™ what you want to accomplish, your deadline, and your real hours. It builds the full step-by-step plan, tracks your risk score live, and tells you exactly what to do next — every week, until the goal is accomplished.

launches.name: Calorie Checker - AI Food Scan
launches.tagline: Snap a Photo. See the Calories
launches.description: Just point your camera at food and get a calorie estimate in seconds. No onboarding. No macro tracking. No meal plans. No streaks. Every other calorie app wants to be your fitness coach, meal planner, habit tracker, and life coach. But you just wanted to know how many calories are in your lunch. That's Calorie Checker. Nothing more, nothing less. Calorie Checker uses AI to estimate the calories in your food from a single photo. No setup. No daily homework. Snap, see the number, move on.

launches.name: Parasol
launches.tagline: Zero-friction vacation calendar for teams and friend groups.
launches.description: Tracking team time off in spreadsheets is painful. HR software is overkill. Parasol fits in-between: a vacation calendar that lives at a secure URL. No accounts, no signups, no credit cards. -> Horizontal multi-month view with dedicated rows per teammate -> Nuanced statuses: Available (workations), Partial, Out of Reach -> Overlay holidays from any country — built for global teams -> Optional password layer for sensitive boards Setup takes 10 seconds. Free forever for small teams. Have fun!

launches.name: MacRest
launches.tagline: Take control of when your Mac sleeps.
launches.description: A small Mac utility that catches the apps quietly blocking sleep and gives you the kind of control macOS doesn't offer on its own.

launches.name: Attendify
launches.tagline: Attendency,security monitering and school management system
launches.description: Attendify is a smart school management system for tracking student attendance and managing visitor security. Built by Vexovin Intelligent Systems.

launches.name: Menu Builder
launches.tagline: Put your restaurant menu online in minutes.
launches.description: Create a restaurant website with structured online menu pages. Replace PDF menus with QR-ready pages, keep details current, and publish AI-translated menus.

launches.name: Saasclip
launches.tagline: Create product launch videos in seconds. No editing required
launches.description: Every Saas needs product launch videos. Saasclips automates that for you and generates 5 launch styles native to X.

launches.name: VertiTab
launches.tagline: Cross-Browser Bookmark Sharing, Cloud Sync & Tab Lock
launches.description: All-in-one tab manager: save & restore sessions, AI grouping, bookmark sync, workspaces. Tree tabs with cloud sync across devices.

launches.name: Stridely
launches.tagline: The security audit your vibe code never got.
launches.description: Continuous STRIDE threat modeling for AI-generated and vibe-coded applications. Connect a GitHub repo and ship safer code on every push.

launches.name: Streak Society - Lets improve
launches.tagline: One Day or Day One
launches.description: Streaksociety.com is a platform to find and connect motivated people who want to self improve by being consistent. They can see their consistency proof at one place along with all the data of their tasks and streaks. Streaksociety.com wants to be platform of such people who want to change. On streaksociety.com you can find such people whose mentality aligns with yours. Get motivated or be someone who motivates others.
